structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Chesapeake Bay Bridge and Tunnel District and Commission

law.catch_line: Consent of Commonwealth to use subaqueous soil of the Chesapeake Bay
law.text: The Commonwealth hereby consents to the use by the Commission, in any manner whatsoever in the performance of its duties, of all lands lying under the waters of the Chesapeake Bay that are within the Commonwealth and are deemed by the Commission to be necessary for the construction or operation of the project.
